en: Thank you $g mister : miss; for finding my necklace!  You're the best!
But your real punishment lies ahead.
I can feel the presence of evil leaving...

Buliwyf, the dwarven weapon master right here at the Timberline Arms, teaches fist weapons, guns, one and two-handed axes and one and two-handed maces.

Woo Ping, the human weapon master at Weller's Arsenal in Stormwind, teaches crossbow, daggers, one and two-handed swords, polearms, and staff.

Ilyenia Moonfire, the night elf weapon master, resides at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus where she teaches bow, daggers, fist weapons, staff and throwing weapons.
Your moldering remains will serve ME as a testament to what happens when one is foolish enough to trespass in my domain!
What you be expectin', mon?$B$BMaywiki only be dealin' with the druids and shaman.
Finally, I am free! I come home soon, my dear!
Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.
Haha! Sturdy old Trollplow has just a few meager battle scars!
Fascinating, this coincides with theories of Un'Goro being the home of the Titans when they inhabited Kalimdor. Perhaps Aman'thul himself watched over 'The God Lands.'
They say a stitch in time saves... what, eleven? Ah, I can't remember. Stupid saying anyway.
A time consuming, yet rewarding skill.  Speak with Astaia in the Tradesman's Terrace and maybe you'll learn something useful.

Greetings, $c. Don't have too much time to talk--I'm just using Chillwind as a camp to get some rest before heading to Hearthglen. I've heard word that before they went crazy, the Scarlet Crusade had a mage working for them who was trying to create powerful bows and guns for their soldiers. I'm not sure if he succeeded or not... the Crusade killed him before any of his finished product made it out. Maybe they killed him to keep it a secret... or maybe they distrust the arcane that much.
I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.
%s is surrounded by a barrier of anti-magic.
Hey Nagmara!  How about a mug of Dark Iron Ale?
I don't quite understand...
Kel'thuzad make Patchwerk his avatar of war!
If you have lost a piece of your Zandalarian armor, I may be able to help you.
%s disappears in a cloud of dust.
Ah!  Please, if you see a survivor of Darrowshire, tell them I am free!

Ansekhwa, da tauren weapon master, is on da Thunder Bluff lower rise.  He teach one and two-handed maces, staves and guns.

Archibald, da undead weapon master in da War Quarter of da Undercity, train good with crossbows, daggers, one and two-handed swords and polearms.

Sayoc, da ugly orc right here, can teach da ways of bows, daggers, fist weapons, one and two-handed axes and thrown weapons mon.
Lady Jaina, this may sound like an odd request... but I have a young ward who is quite shy.  You are a hero to him, and he asked me to get your autograph.
Hello, $N. Are you interested in outdoor survival? Sustenance off the flaura and fauna of the lands!$B$BYou could learn a thing or two from me, that is, if you're interested.
Let me know when it is best to ride. You must be our eyes and ears on the battlefront.

Un'Goro Crater be far to the south of Kalimdor. Beyond the Thousand Needles in Tanaris. Look for the large floating stones... they mark the entrance to the Crater. But be careful... it is no easy path. The raptors are not far from the entrance.
Tai'jin is her name and you'll find her inside the barracks on the east side of Razor Hill.  She'll teach you to respect the gods.  Make certain that you show her the proper respect in return!
ALE!

There are plants in Felwood that may be saved from corruption when Cenarion plant salve is applied to them.  I know how to make the salve from several different kinds of items; based on your skill set, you may find that you have multiple options to assist me.$B$BYou will also need a Cenarion beacon for your work here; it is a device that allows you to see the taint and corruption of nature that the naked eye will miss.
Nathanos, I have lost the rotten apple. I require another.
I will not forrrget what you have done...$B$BPleassse, leave meee...
No... you can't sit on my lap.
What is a "subterranean being matrix"?
For so long, I was lost... The Nightmare's corruption had consumed me... And now, you... all of you... you have saved me. Released me from its grasp.
You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.
